biggest_catch: The new member must list your name on the online membership application or provide it in branch at account opening - if they open the account without naming you, no bonus is paid - and the offer is not valid for existing Heartland memberships.
catches: New member must open a membership and list the referring member's name on the Online Membership Application or provide it in branch at account opening.
Referring member must be in good standing; Heartland employees are not eligible for the referral bonus.
Offer not valid for existing Heartland memberships - new members only; minimum $5 to open membership.
Referral bonus deposited into each Savings account within 30 days of account opening.
Referral and account opening bonus may be reported to the IRS; program details subject to change and cannot be combined with any other offer.
